title: Noragami OVA
summary: AniList 20494 bundles the two S1-era Noragami OADs that Kodansha shipped with the LIMITED EDITIONS of manga volumes 10 and 11 (kc.kodansha.co.jp item 0000039887, 2014年02月17日, ISBN 978-4-06-358479-0; item 0000039888, 2014年07月17日, ISBN 978-4-06-358480-6) — AniList's single 2014-02-17 is the FIRST one's ship date only. Both animate printed chapters of Adachitoka's own manga, and both are chapters of VOLUME 7. OAD 1 「神憑り、神祟り」 is chapter 25 「触った神の祟り」: Kodansha's own product copy says 「原作第25話神憑りのお話をオリジナルアニメーションで収録！」, ja-WP says 「第1話は原作第25話・神憑りの話」 and the Noragami Wiki's OVA 1 page says 'based on Chapter 25'. OAD 2 「春の日の約束」 is chapter 24 「ずっと一…」 (the hanami) in its first half — ja-WP 「第2話は原作第24話・お花見の話」, the wiki's OVA 2 page, and Kodansha's 「原作で大人気のお花見のお話をアニメ化！」 — and ノラガミ拾遺集 (Stray Stories) chapter 2 「神器の心中を問う事」 in its second half (the wiki's OVA 2 page AND that chapter's own page say so; MangaUpdates' separate Shuuishuu record starts its anime coverage at 'Vol 1, Chap 2'). No source reports an original STORY in either OAD; the only original material anyone names sits inside OAD 1's adapted plot (a soccer-club set piece, Yukine and Mayu fetching Tenjin, a Kouto Fujisaki appearance, one Kofuku line) while the chapter's own climax — the phantom-possessed peeping student, the rescue, the dislocated shoulder — is ch 25's (the wiki cites ch 25 for the shoulder injury; Kodansha's synopsis carries 「そんな時、校内で事件がおこり」 as part of the ch-25 story). Under T28's faithfulness clause that is divergence, so the entry is CANON. The surprise is the position: the stored 7.5 is OAD 1's ship date landing mid-S1, but S1's own frontier is ch 12 (MU: 'Vol 4, Chap 12 (S1+OVA)'; our eps 10-12 are the anime-original Rabō arc), and the OADs' vol-7 material is reached only in Aragoto ep 7 = our row 19 — which animates ch 24's closing beat and ch 25's Divine Council half and skips exactly what the OADs carry.

chapters_adapted.note: OAD 2 「春の日の約束」 (vol 11 LE, 2014-07-17), first half — printed ch 24 「ずっと一…」 (vol 7, 43 pp, MSM 2012-11-06): the picnic under Suzuha's cherry tree with Bishamon and her shinki, Kofuku, Daikoku, Tenjin and his shinki; Kazuma telling Hiyori about the masked ayakashi; Tenjin's warning; the drunken Yato/Bishamon brawl; Hiyori refusing to let Yato cut ties. weight: significant — it is the OAD's entire first half and the chapter's own body; NEW, not a duplicate: Aragoto ep 7 (our row 19) takes only ch 24's closing beat (Hiyori reminding Yato of her wish), so the picnic is animated nowhere else in the 25-row run. Sources: ja-WP (第2話は原作第24話・お花見の話), noragami.fandom OVA 2 + Bishamonten Arc ch-24 summary, Kodansha's own 「原作で大人気のお花見のお話をアニメ化！」. The OAD's SECOND half adapts ノラガミ拾遺集 ch 2 (18 pp) — the author's own side-story line, no mainline number, delivered as a side_story fact in the flags, never as an anchor.

OAD 1 「神憑り、神祟り」 (vol 10 LE, 2014-02-17) — printed ch 25 「触った神の祟り」 (vol 7, 43 pp, MSM 2012-12-06), the 神憑り half: Hiyori's high-school debut, Yato possessing her body, the rampage and 'missionary work', Kofuku joining in, the student possessed by a phantom photographing the girls' changing room, his suicide attempt, Yato's rescue and the dislocated shoulder, the punishment, the next day's reputation. weight: significant — it is the OAD's whole plot, and the licensor states the equation outright (「原作第25話神憑りのお話をオリジナルアニメーションで収録！」). NEW, not a duplicate: ch 25's OTHER half (the Divine Council interrogating Bishamon, Ebisu's and Iwami's debut) is what Aragoto ep 7 = our row 19 adapts; the possession story is animated nowhere else in the run. Divergence inside the chapter, not weighed toward mixed (T28 faithfulness clause): a soccer-club sequence, Yukine and Mayu fetching Tenjin to stop Yato, a Kouto Fujisaki appearance and one Kofuku line — the four items noragami.fandom lists as not in the chapter.

position.why: 7.5 is OAD 1's SHIP date (2014-02-17, between our rows 7 and 8) and nothing else; OAD 2 shipped 2014-07-17, four months after S1's finale, so no single air-date slot describes the entry. The material is vol-7 (chs 24-25) and the run reaches it only in Aragoto ep 7 = our row 19 (row arithmetic: our 25 rows are S1's 12 then Aragoto's 13, so 12 + 7 = 19; aired 2015-11-13; the wiki gives its chapters as 18, 22, 24, 25, 26) — the episode that animates ch 24's closing beat and ch 25's Divine Council and skips precisely the picnic and the possession the OADs carry. At the stored 7.5 the viewer is around ch 9 (S1's own frontier is ch 12 per MU 'Vol 4, Chap 12 (S1+OVA)'; rows 10-12 are the anime-original Rabō arc, noragami.fandom 'Rabou Arc — an anime-only arc'), so both OADs would spoil the entire Bishamonten arc (Bishamon and Yato reconciled and drinking together, Suzuha's memorial cherry tree, Kazuma's masked-ayakashi conversation) and show Hiyori in a high school she does not enter until row 19. No licensor numbering exists to override the story position: the S1 and Aragoto BD/DVD volumes carry only the TV episodes and nothing numbers the OADs into the run (unlike Attack on Titan's #3.25 / #3.5 / #3.75). 19.5 = after row 19, the first point at which both OADs are in order and spoil nothing.

flags_for_sean: TWO WORKS, ONE ENTRY, TWO DATES. AniList 20494 is 2 episodes: OAD 1 「神憑り、神祟り」 with the vol 10 limited edition (2014-02-17, ISBN 978-4-06-358479-0) and OAD 2 「春の日の約束」 with the vol 11 limited edition (2014-07-17, ISBN 978-4-06-358480-6) — both Kodansha product pages read, both ISBNs in ja-WP's 書誌情報, en-WP says the same in English. AniList's single date is OAD 1's; if the halo ever stores a date for this row the honest value is the pair, not 2014-02-17 alone. If the entry is ever SPLIT into two rows: OAD 1 = canon, ch 25, position 19.5; OAD 2 = canon, ch 24 + Stray Stories ch 2, position 18.5 (its chapter closes the Bishamonten arc that our row 18 = Aragoto ep 6 ends).

POSITION FORK, laid out. (a) 19.5 — PROPOSED: after Aragoto ep 7 (our row 19), the row that reaches chs 24-25 and skips exactly the OADs' parts; nothing spoiled, nothing out of order. (b) 7.5 — STORED: OAD 1's ship date only, mid-S1, ~15 chapters and one whole arc early; it would spoil the Bishamon arc and show Hiyori in high school 12 rows before she enters it. (c) 12.5 — the release-era slot en-WP implies by printing both OADs at the foot of its SEASON 1 table; same spoiler problem as (b). (d) 18.5 — defensible for OAD 2 alone. There is NO licensor ordering to settle it the AoT way: ja-WP's OAD table numbers the four OADs 「Number = !INVISIBLE」, and the S1 / Aragoto BD-DVD tables (収録話 columns) carry only the TV episodes. Note also that the bundle's own ship order is the REVERSE of the manga's: OAD 1 = ch 25, OAD 2 = ch 24.

拾遺集 (Stray Stories) — one work or two? OAD 2's second half adapts ノラガミ拾遺集 ch 2 「神器の心中を問う事」 (18 pp; collected in 拾遺集 第壱巻, 2013-11-15, ISBN 978-4-06-371398-5): the shinki job-placement magazine, Mayu's scathing interview, Yukine's questionnaire, Yato's king emblem turned into a poop emblem — the wiki's OVA 2 page and the chapter's own page agree, and MU's Shuuishuu record opens its anime coverage at 'Vol 1, Chap 2'. It is Adachitoka's own 番外編 line, serialized in 月刊少年マガジン+ and listed INSIDE ノラガミ's own 書誌情報 on ja-WP, so under the GTO rule (a side story serialized inside the source IS the source) and the kaguya-sama precedent I read it as the instrument — the entry is plain canon, and the chapter takes NO anchor because it has no mainline number. Suggested annotation: side_story{ノラガミ拾遺集 ch 2 「神器の心中を問う事」, 拾遺集 第壱巻 2013-11-15, not in the 1-109 mainline space}. UNLIKE Kaguya's Darkness, MangaUpdates DOES hold Shuuishuu as its own series (73505480218, relation 'Side Story') and AniList mints it (85392) — so if you rule it a distinct licensed work, T26 makes that half side_source, OAD 2 becomes mixed and the ENTRY becomes mixed; chapters_adapted is unchanged (24, 25).

THAT RULING TOUCHES A TV ROW TOO. S1 ep 4 (our row 4) adapts a Shuuishuu chapter as well: its fandom page's Adaptation Notes read 'This episode is loosely based on a chapter of the original manga, but mainly based on chapter 1 of the spin-off manga Noragami Shuuishuu', and Stray Stories ch 1 「落ちる男の事」 says it 'was adapted into Episode 4'. Whatever you rule for 拾遺集 should be applied to row 4 in the same sitting. (Two source defects to know: the ep-4 infobox links 'Stray Stories Chapter 2' where its own prose says chapter 1, and MU's Shuuishuu coverage string says 'Skips Chap 1' — neither disturbs SS ch 2 → OAD 2, which two independent pages plus MU's start pin agree on.)

T28 SIZING on OAD 1, stated so it can be re-ruled without re-research. The episode's job is ch 25's possession story (the licensor says so in as many words). The original material anyone names — the soccer-club sequence, Yukine and Mayu fetching Tenjin, a Kouto Fujisaki appearance, one Kofuku line — is expansion INSIDE that plot, and the plot's climax is the chapter's (noragami.fandom's Divine Possession page cites {{CHref|c25}} for Yato dislocating Hiyori's shoulder in the rescue; Kodansha's own synopsis carries 「そんな時、校内で事件がおこり」 inside the ch-25 sentence). That is divergence under the faithfulness clause → canon. I could not size the added share in minutes: no source gives a runtime breakdown and I did not read the chapter's pages, so the estimate ('a set piece, not a second story') rests on the wiki's four-item list and a Japanese viewer walkthrough (ameblo, CROSS-CHECK TIER ONLY — no load-bearing claim rests on it). If you weigh the soccer sequence plus the Tenjin/Mayu errand as a story-carrying original share, OAD 1 alone reads mixed; OAD 2 is source end to end either way, so the ENTRY would still read canon unless you split the row.

COVERAGE VALUE. Ch 24's picnic and ch 25's possession story are animated NOWHERE in the 25-row TV run — Aragoto ep 7 takes only ch 24's closing beat and ch 25's Divine Council (its wiki and en-WP summaries carry neither the picnic nor the possession). If the related-works ledger feeds a 'chapters covered' view, this row is the only coverage those pages have; note the chapters are not wholly unadapted, so the honest statement is 'the OADs are the sole adaptation of those PARTS of chs 24-25'.

SIBLING ENTRY LEAD (outside this work, unverified beyond the two reads named). The OTHER Noragami OVA AniList entry is the ARAGOTO pair — 「夜ト神連続殺人事件 ノラガミサスペンス劇場」 (vol 16 LE, 2015-11-17) and 「一緒に写真を」 (vol 17 LE, 2016-03-17). noragami.fandom gives their sources as Stray Stories ch 6 and mainline ch 41 respectively, which is what MU's main-series segment 'Vol 11, Chap 41 (S2+OVA) Skip Chap 40' is counting. Read that way MU's 41 is the OVA's, not a TV row's — it is not evidence against our stored terminal (ep 25 → END ch 39 = the last chapter of vol 10, the Yomi arc's close per the fandom's arc page). Also for that entry: its fandom pages date the two OADs Nov 15 2015 / Mar 18 2016 while ja-WP and Kodansha say 11月17日 / 3月17日.

TITLE detail, no repair here: the official title of OAD 2 is 「春の日の約束」 (ja-WP's OAD table and dAnime Store's work page 『ノラガミ（OAD) 春の日の約束（全1話）』); noragami.fandom and en-WP print 「春の約束」 / 'A Promise in Spring'. Our row's stored title is AniList's bundle title 'Noragami OVA', which is correct as a bundle label.

CHAPTER SPACE CHECKED, no shift. noragami.fandom's volume table gives vol 7 = chs 24-27 and vol 10 = chs 36-39 with 27 volumes and 109 chapters, matching ja-WP's volume dates and ISBNs, the context's 'latest known 109 / total 109', and our stored terminal (ep 25 → 39 = vol 10's last chapter); Azuki's official English digital edition numbers chapters 1..N contiguously with no decimals across this range. Chs 24 and 25 are printed mainline numbers in our own space — no conversion applied.
